mapper.select: select state, source_ref as sourceRef, delta_millis as deltaMillis, horizon_millis as horizonMillis, grace_millis as graceMillis, merge_window_millis as mergeWindowMillis, state_rule as stateRule, max_events as maxEvents, page_size as pageSize, board_id as boardId, region_id as regionId, season_id as seasonId, rules_version as rulesVersion, metric_version as metricVersion from city_fairness_parameter where state = 'APPROVED' and board_id = #{boardId} and region_id = #{regionId} and season_id = #{seasonId} and rules_version = #{rulesVersion}

select source_ref as source, event_id as eventId, outing_id as outingId, kind, actor_id as actorId, occurred_at as occurredAt, known_at as knownAt, subject_source as subjectSource, subject_event_id as subjectEventId, join_time as joinTime, team_size as teamSize, action_cost as actionCost, newcomer, gain_amount as gainAmount, verification_millis as verificationMillis, board_id as boardId, region_id as regionId, season_id as seasonId, rules_version as rulesVersion from city_fairness_event where board_id = #{boardId} and region_id = #{regionId} and season_id = #{seasonId} and rules_version = #{rulesVersion} and known_at <= #{asOfInclusive} and occurred_at <= #{asOfInclusive} order by known_at, occurred_at, source_ref, event_id limit #{limit}

select source_ref as source, event_id as eventId, outing_id as outingId, kind, actor_id as actorId, occurred_at as occurredAt, known_at as knownAt, subject_source as subjectSource, subject_event_id as subjectEventId, join_time as joinTime, team_size as teamSize, action_cost as actionCost, newcomer, gain_amount as gainAmount, verification_millis as verificationMillis, board_id as boardId, region_id as regionId, season_id as seasonId, rules_version as rulesVersion from city_fairness_event where source_ref = #{source} and event_id = #{eventId}
